topic: The Gulf Stream, a river in the ocean
script: A river inside the ocean carries more water than all the rivers on land combined. It is called the Gulf Stream, and it flows up the east coast of North America. It carries warm water across the Atlantic toward Europe. That warmth helps keep parts of western Europe milder than other places as far north. Benjamin Franklin helped map it and published a chart around 1770. Scientists estimate ocean currents form a global loop that takes about 1,000 years to complete.
